# `iceberg` destination.json fields

Generated from [`destination/iceberg/resources/spec.json`](https://github.com/datazip-inc/olake/blob/v1.1.2/destination/iceberg/resources/spec.json) at `v1.1.2`. The same schema prints with `docker run --rm olakego/source-<source>:v1.1.2 spec --destination-type iceberg`.

Nested fields use dots: `ssl.mode` is `"ssl": {"mode": ...}`. *Required* is relative to the parent object: `ssh_config.type` is required only if `ssh_config` is set. A field marked *only when* exists only in that branch of its parent object.

{
  "writer": {
    "catalog_type": "glue",
    "iceberg_s3_path": "<ICEBERG_S3_PATH>"

}
